es: Reconocer en una anécdota breve tiempos verbales, condicionales, causativos y verbos de reporte del nivel.

teaching.en: Carlos told an anecdote: he had been saving for a year when his phone was stolen.
teaching.es: Carlos contó una anécdota: llevaba un año ahorrando cuando le robaron el teléfono.
teaching.explanationEs: Had been saving es una actividad en curso anterior al robo (was stolen, pasiva del pasado).
segments: Carlos told an anecdote: he had been saving
for a year when his phone was stolen.
teaching.audioText: Carlos told an anecdote: he had been saving for a year when his phone was stolen.

teaching.en: Afterwards, he had the phone replaced at a small shop.
teaching.es: Después, hizo que le cambiaran el teléfono en una tienda pequeña.
teaching.explanationEs: Had + cosa + participio: otra persona hace la acción por ti (causativo).
teaching.audioText: Afterwards, he had the phone replaced at a small shop.

teaching.en: The assistant told him that he should have bought insurance.
teaching.es: El dependiente le dijo que debería haber comprado un seguro.
teaching.explanationEs: Told him that es un reporte; should have + participio critica algo que no se hizo.
teaching.audioText: The assistant told him that he should have bought insurance.

teaching.en: If he hadn't been so careless, he would still have his phone today.
teaching.es: Si no hubiera sido tan descuidado, todavía tendría su teléfono hoy.
teaching.explanationEs: If + had + participio, would + verbo base: causa pasada y resultado presente (condicional mixto).
segments: If he hadn't been so careless, he
would still have his phone today.
teaching.audioText: If he hadn't been so careless, he would still have his phone today.

teaching.en: He admitted that he had never read the rules.
teaching.es: Admitió que nunca había leído las normas.
teaching.explanationEs: Admitted that + oración: verbo de reporte; had read sitúa lo leído antes de admitirlo.
teaching.audioText: He admitted that he had never read the rules.

prompt.es: ¿En cuál de estas oraciones una actividad venía ocurriendo antes de otro hecho pasado?

choices.text: Sara has been waiting for an hour, and the bus is late.
Sara had been waiting for an hour when the bus came.
Sara waited for the bus and went home.

feedback.es: Had been waiting describe una actividad en curso antes de que llegara el autobús. Has been waiting llega hasta hoy, y waited and went home es un hecho terminado.

hint.es: Busca had been + verbo con -ing y un segundo hecho en pasado.

prompt.es: ¿En cuál de estas oraciones otra persona hace algo por Tom?

choices.text: Tom repaired his bike on Monday.
Tom has repaired his bike twice.
Tom had his bike repaired on Monday.

feedback.es: Had + cosa + participio significa que el arreglo lo hizo otra persona. Las otras dos dicen que Tom lo arregló o lo ha arreglado él mismo.

prompt.es: Completa: «La doctora me dijo que descansara.»

feedback.es: Con told va siempre una persona antes de that: told me that.

hint.es: Con told va la persona a quien se le dice.

origin.text: The doctor told ___ that I should rest.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada oración con la estructura que contiene.

pairs: I had been running when it started to rain.

pairs.es: actividad en curso anterior a otro hecho

pairs: If I hadn't missed the bus, I would be at work now.

pairs.es: condicional: causa pasada, resultado de hoy

pairs: Mia had her hair cut on Friday.

pairs.es: otra persona lo hace por ti

pairs: Leo admitted that he had lost the key.

feedback.es: Cada pista en la forma revela un significado: had been + -ing, if + had + participio, had + cosa + participio y admitted that.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué describe la frase.

choices.text: An activity that was in progress before the concert.
A plan for the next concert.
Something that will happen after the concert.

feedback.es: Had been standing describe una actividad en curso antes del concierto: estuvieron de pie haciendo fila durante tres horas.

origin.audio: Before the concert, we had been standing in line for three hours.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Si no hubiera llovido, habríamos ido a la playa.»

answer.text: If it hadn't rained we would have gone to the beach

feedback.es: El condicional del pasado lleva if + had + participio y would have + participio.

prompt.es: En el texto de Leo, ¿qué oración es el condicional que une un hecho pasado con hoy?

choices.text: He told me that he should have rested.
If he hadn't hurt his knee, he would be at the race today.
Leo had been training for a race when he hurt his knee.

feedback.es: If + had + participio, would + base conecta la lesión pasada con lo que no puede hacer hoy. Las otras dos frases son un reporte y una actividad anterior.

origin.text: Last year Leo had been training for a race when he hurt his knee. He told me that he should have rested. If he hadn't hurt his knee, he would be at the race today.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige quién arregló el coche.

choices.text: She fixed it herself.
Her brother fixed it at home.
A mechanic fixed it for her.

feedback.es: Had her car repaired indica que lo hizo un mecánico por ella, no que lo arregló ella misma.

origin.audio: Sara had her car repaired at the garage on Monday.

prompt.es: Completa: «Si no me hubiera perdido, habría llegado a tiempo.»

feedback.es: El resultado de un condicional del pasado se forma con would have + participio.

origin.text: If I hadn't got lost, I ___ arrived on time.

prompt.es: Tom suspendió el examen porque no estudió. ¿Qué frase expresa su arrepentimiento?

choices.text: I should have studied more.
I should study more next time.
I would study more if I could.

feedback.es: Should have + participio lamenta algo que ya pasó. Las otras dos miran al futuro o a una posibilidad.

origin.text: Tom no estudió y suspendió el examen.

prompt.es: ¿Cuál de estas oraciones reporta algo que alguien admitió?

choices.text: Ana had her tickets printed at the shop.
Ana admitted that she had forgotten the tickets.
Ana has been forgetting her tickets all week.

feedback.es: Admitted that reporta lo que Ana reconoció. Las otras frases son un causativo y una actividad que dura hasta hoy.

prompt.es: Completa: «Hicieron que un albañil les arreglara el tejado.»

feedback.es: En el causativo, después de have + cosa va el participio: had the roof repaired.

origin.text: They had the roof ___ by a builder last summer.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Llevaba dos años ahorrando cuando lo compró.»

answer.text: She had been saving for two years when she bought it

feedback.es: Had been saving + for two years presenta la actividad anterior al momento de la compra.
